properties.name: EXCON
properties.text: Serial 1 started. Sea state 3, wind south-west 15 kn, visibility good.

properties.name: RED ONE
properties.text: Dived north-east of the area. Intention: transit south-west undetected.

properties.name: BLUE ONE
properties.text: On task. Searching the north-east of the area with bow sonar.

properties.name: BLUE ONE
properties.text: Contact classified submarine, designated RED ONE, bearing 281.8°T.

properties.name: BLUE ONE
properties.text: Holding RED ONE. Request permission to simulate an attack.

properties.name: BLUE ONE
properties.text: Simulated attack on RED ONE complete.

properties.name: EXCON
properties.text: Closest approach of BLUE ONE and RED ONE: 2.29 nmi.

properties.name: RED ONE
properties.text: Communications window missed. Continuing to the south-west.

properties.name: EXCON
properties.text: Serial 1 ended. Units reposition for Serial 2.
